prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose How to Create Your Pet", "Select a quick preset companion or build a custom pet from photos.", "Quick Starter Pet (30 sec)", "Custom AI Pet (Photo Upload)"]
1: ["Returning user? Sign in with your original account method to keep your saved pets from resetting."]
2: ["Pick Your Desktop Pet Companion", "Choose from verified visual styles that render smoothly on your desktop.", "Select Species & Personality"]
3: ["Configuring Desktop Pet Window", "Generating pet animations", "Checking desktop window overlay permissions"]
4: ["How to Control Your Desktop Pet", "Drag your pet anywhere on screen. Right-click the pet to talk, customize settings, or send them to the system tray.", "Ready to Launch!", "Your pet is active on your desktop. Enjoy your new companion!"]
5: ["Meet Your Desktop Companion in 2 Minutes", "Create and customize a virtual pet that lives right on your computer desktop.", "Start Setup"]
6: ["Sign In to Save Companion Progress", "Continue with Google", "Continue with Email"]
7: ["Upload Clear Pet Photos", "Upload front-facing photos with good lighting for best results.", "Validating Photo Quality", "We are inspecting your photo clarity to ensure your 3D desktop pet renders perfectly."]
8: ["We'll ping your desktop as soon as your pet is ready to spawn!"]
9: ["Claim Your Free Starter Pet Toy!", "Complete setup now to receive a free interactive toy for your new pet.", "Exclusive Starter Item Unlocked"]

verdicts.problem: Mentions free gifts/extras and creates urgency to complete setup
